plan_id.description: Id for this plan submission (UUID recommended). Content identity is sha256( JCS-canonicalized plan JSON ) and is represented as `sha256:<hex>`.

actor.description: Selectors describing who requested the launch (optional; never embed secrets).

target.description: Where the microVM should be launched.

expect_generation_digest.description: Optional guard: deny if the host is not running this generation digest.

instance.description: Stable instance identity and human labels (used for receipts and idempotency).

role.description: Optional role hint (db, web, build, desktop, ...).

runtime_manifest_digest.description: Digest of the compiled runtime.manifest to realize (backend-facing contract).

artifact_digest.description: Optional digest of the workload artifact/bundle the runtime manifest refers to.

policy_digest.description: Digest of the policy module(s) authorizing this launch (local authority boundary).

requested.description: Caller-provided knobs. Policy may tighten, ignore, or deny. Avoid embedding secrets; use leases/references.

leases.description: Optional lease ids that must be usable during launch (secrets, device grants, trace grants, ...).
